Name: Ilucie's Adopt a Hermy
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Now you are able to adopt a cute, little Hermit Crab from Marnie!

This mod implements a new custom pet and doesn't replace existing files, so you can have your Hermit Crab alongside your dogs, cats and turtles!


I may implement more colors in the future, because you know... Hermit Crabs feel better in groups :)

Downloads.Description: fixed a bug where a Hermy would drop an Error Item

Manifest.Description: Adopt a Hermit Crab as your Pet
